channel.title: Documents Without Borders
channel.description: Notarization, apostille, authentication, and translation services for documents used across borders.

item.title: What Is an Apostille and When Do You Need One?
item.description: If your documents are going to be used in another country, you may need an apostille. Here is what it is, who needs it, and how long it takes.

item.title: How to Get U.S. Documents Ready for International Use
item.description: From notarization to state authentication to embassy legalization - the step-by-step process to make your U.S. documents valid abroad.

item.title: Certified Translation: What Counts and What Does Not
item.description: Not every translation is accepted by governments and embassies. Learn what makes a certified translation valid for official use.
